description: Use when the user wants to continue, change or ask about a project they saved ("continue the booking app", "where was I", "add SMS to my project"). Reads only; needs sign-in. Returns the accepted plan without the user repeating it: requirements (with their source sentences), accepted decisions and their history, the services and plans selected, users now and at forecast, budget, region, platforms and builder, the linked repo and billing accounts, what is still assumed or unresolved, setup progress, and how fresh each part is, plus the context_version to pass to later calls. Pass id when you have it (from list_saved_stacks or an earlier answer). Pass name only with the words the user used: when more than one project matches, or only part of the name does, it returns status "needs_clarification" with one question and the candidates, and you must ask that question rather than pick one. Proposals ("add SMS reminders") are not applied here: price them with price_change, and change the project only with accept_change after the user agrees.

framework.description: What the app is built with, for the setup steps (default nextjs).

name.description: The project name as the user said it, e.g. "booking app". Never guessed: an unclear match asks.

name: get_project_context

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

completeness.description: On plan and project results: complete, complete_with_assumptions, incomplete or needs_clarification, with the reasons. Say plainly when it is not complete.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

project.description: On results about a saved project: its id and the context version the answer was computed on. Pass both back in follow-up calls.

title: Continue a saved project
